text:
noah: Quick Q after booking: used corporate card for hotel but accidentally paid incidentals (mini-bar) on my personal card at checkout. How to reconcile?

liz (People Ops): Company policy: incidental personal charges go on personal card. Submit your personal receipt for the incidentals if you want reimbursement only if they were business-related. Otherwise mark as personal non-reimbursable.

noah: Understood. The hotel posted a single folio, corporate card payment shows as one line but my card shows separate charge. I have both receipts.

josh (Finance): Perfect. Upload folio + your cc statement line. Create two expense lines: mark folio as corporate-card (no reimbursement), and add personal incidental line with receipt. Add a short note mapping folio line items to payments.

noah: Also, the agency accidentally charged the conference fee twice then refunded one charge in EUR. The refund shows up as a single credit on my card statement in EUR but converted by bank to USD. How to show this?

josh (Finance): Include the original charge receipt, the refund transaction line, and a screenshot of the card statement showing both. Put a note with the original EUR amounts and the USD conversions. We reconcile at the posted bank rate.

noah: Lost a receipt for a $40 taxi. I remember amount and have the card transaction. Will finance accept a missing receipt affidavit?

liz (People Ops): Yes for <$75 we accept missing receipt form + card transaction screenshot and a short note. Use the "Missing Receipt Affidavit" template in Expensify.

noah: One more: manager approved a $350 client dinner. The check was $1400 for 8 ppl. I paid personally and collected shares. Can I claim more than $200 for my line?

josh (Finance): If manager pre-approved, fine. Submit itemized receipt, list participants, your share, and attach the manager approval (email or Slack thread). We reimburse your share. If your per-person share >$200 then add manager approval note.

noah: Thanks. Final oddball: conference provided breakfasts on days 1-3 and a boxed lunch on day 2. I used per-diem option. Do I mark all provided meals?

liz (People Ops): Yes mark each provided meal in the per-diem selection. The system deducts those meal portions from the daily per-diem. If unsure, choose actuals and upload receipts.

travel-team-bot: Travel policy: https://redwoodintranet.company/travel-policy See sections: "Corporate card reconciliation", "Per-diem offsets", "Missing receipts".

noah: Great, i'll submit the bundle now. If finance needs anything else i'll reply here. Thanks!
